steps.title: A pearl diver
steps.body: Swimming, climbing and following are built-in behaviours too: Swimmer and Climber for the hero, Follower for neighbours. Here the hero becomes a pearl diver who holds its breath three times as long. First, a hero: in the Scene's Starter pack, Play as Rook.

steps.title: Read about Swimmer
steps.body: In Logic, under Built-in, press Swimmer. Its hooks: canDive (can the hero dive now?) and breath (seconds of air, asked every step; super.breath(e) is Project › Swimming's).

steps.title: Three times the air
steps.body: Press Extend and write it: a field for how many times the air, breath returns the project's breath times it, and canDive says so in the Console before giving the engine's answer.

code: lungs = field.number(3, { label: "Times the air", min: 1, max: 10 });

steps.title: Put it on Rook
steps.body: In Characters, Rook's Behaviour tab: + Script → My Swimmer. Hero, Swimmer and Climber are listed as Rook's built-ins.

steps.title: Sixty seconds of air
steps.body: Press Play. The hero now has 60 seconds of air (20 × 3): under water the HUD counts down from 60, and the Debug tab's variables show maxAir 60.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: Climber.canClimbWall decides whether the hero takes hold of a wall (no climbing in the rain, or only with climbing gloves), and Follower.followGap how close a following neighbour keeps (a shy one keeps 8 studs back).
